icd_linked.llm_icd_reason: Mapped code at matched rank is N93.9 (abnormal uterine and vaginal bleeding, unspecified), a nonspecific symptom code that does not capture the postprocedural/complication nature of the billed N99.820 (postprocedural hemorrhage of a genitourinary organ following a GU procedure). Coding guidelines require the complication code when bleeding follows a surgical procedure, and N93.9 (uterine/vaginal bleeding) is also inconsistent after hysterectomy, so a coder would not accept it as equivalent.
